title: Review the {{channel}} service
readOnly: Read only: your role cannot record a decision.

states.loading: Loading the service and its version…
states.forbidden: You do not have access to this service.
states.not_found: This service was not found in this dossier.
states.recovery: No decision was inferred from this error. Return to the desk or try reading the data again.

stale.title: The reviewed version needs to be checked
stale.description: A different version was retrieved or the last action has an uncertain result. Read the recorded state before making another decision.

summary.title: Preparation summary
summary.prepared: Prepared content is available. Review its appearance and checks before deciding. Publication remains a separate step.
summary.notReady: No proposal matches this service yet. The available information can still be consulted.

provenance.unlinked: The link to an external Preflight proposal has not been verified. No content is attributed to AI without confirmed provenance.

preview.caption: Private preview, without publication. Web uses Funding’s public component; social platform layouts may differ.

text.provenance: This content comes from the preparation saved in Funding. Its version remains identifiable in the history.
text.regenerationUnavailable: Automatic Preflight rewriting is not connected to this workflow.
text.notReady: The text for this service is not available yet. Open the dossier to continue preparing it.

media.shared: One media library for this dossier. Selections and usage rights remain specific to each destination; Web approval does not authorize social publication.

checks.title: Controls and checks
checks.explanation: These checks describe facts recorded in Funding. Having text or an image does not establish editorial compliance.
checks.humanRecorded: A decision is recorded for this version.
checks.humanScope: The decision covers this private proposal. It cancels no obligation and authorizes no publication.

attention.title: Points requiring attention
attention.human: The preparation awaits your judgement. Private approval allows the delivery workflow to continue; publication authorization remains separate.
attention.recorded: The decision for this version is retained. A content change will require a new review.

blockers.payment: Check payment eligibility in the dossier.
blockers.consent: The required consent must be verified.
blockers.media: Media or its usage rights require intervention.
blockers.content: The proposal must be completed or match this exact service.
blockers.agreement: The agreement or promised service must be confirmed.
blockers.review: A business or editorial validation is still required.
blockers.other: A preparation condition is not satisfied. Open the dossier and the check reference.

details.authority: Funding owns the agreement, rights, decisions, delivery and evidence. Technical references identify the exact reviewed version.

history.empty: No decision has been recorded for this service yet.

approvalGuidance.readonly: Your role allows viewing preparations, but does not allow approving them.
approvalGuidance.busy: An operation is in progress. Wait for its result before approving.
approvalGuidance.unavailable: The preparation could not be reloaded. Refresh its state before approving.
approvalGuidance.uncertain: Check the result of your last action before making another approval.
approvalGuidance.session-inactive: Your work session is paused or finished. Resume it before deciding; a finished session can also be replaced by a new session.
approvalGuidance.stale: The reviewed version needs checking. Reload the recorded state before approving; your unsaved entries are retained.
approvalGuidance.dirty: Your private draft changes have not been saved. Save them before approving this preparation.
approvalGuidance.buffer-readonly: This service is no longer editable in the workshop. Your entries remain readable and copyable; they cannot replace the saved content.
approvalGuidance.recorded: A decision has already been recorded for this version. View its history to continue.
approvalGuidance.missing-draft: This exact service does not yet have a private draft to approve. Complete its preparation in Funding.
approvalGuidance.incomplete: Funding does not yet allow approval of this version. Complete its preparation prerequisites.
approvalGuidance.closed: This service is no longer open for another approval. View its workflow and evidence in Funding.

approvalActions.profileSubmissionHelp: To find the sponsor’s private form, open Follow-up access in the dossier toolbar. Saving the form for later or correcting contact details in the administration does not replace submitting the information to the team.

blockerReasons.public_consent_missing: The required public consent has not been recorded.
blockerReasons.sponsor_review_required: The sponsorship must be approved in the Funding dossier.
blockerReasons.moderation_review_required: The required editorial review is not approved for this version.
blockerReasons.company_missing: The organization name is missing from the dossier.
blockerReasons.presentation_missing: The organization presentation is missing from the dossier.
blockerReasons.required_media_missing: The required media have not yet been validated for this destination, including their selection and usage rights.
blockerReasons.prepared_media_stale: An assignment uses an older media or service version. Review it in the dossier’s library.
blockerReasons.prepared_media_unavailable: An assigned media item does not yet have the required rights, review or version for this destination.
blockerReasons.service_draft_missing: No private draft matches this exact promised service.
blockerReasons.obligation_blocked: This promised service is currently blocked in Funding.
blockerReasons.service_closed: This service or its draft is no longer open for another preparation decision.

guided.intro: Review each recorded check and open its Funding owner to complete what is missing. Each check retains its own state; completing one does not approve the preparation.
guided.notRequired: Funding does not require this check for this exact service.
guided.textReviewScope: This review concerns only the saved publication draft identified below. It grants no publication authorization and does not approve the service preparation.

causes.payment: Payment and refund eligibility must be confirmed in the financial record.
causes.agreement: The accepted agreement must identify this exact promised service.
causes.consent: Public use of the organization name and presentation requires recorded consent. Record only an agreement actually received.
causes.dossierReview: The dossier requires its business review and editorial review. The native dossier action reviews both together.
causes.media: Media selection, assignment, current version and usage rights must match this destination.
causes.textReview: The saved publication text needs its own editorial review, distinct from the dossier review.
causes.draft: A private draft must match this exact service, channel and destination.
causes.identity: The organization name must be completed in the sponsor identity.
causes.content: The public presentation or prepared content must be completed in the Funding publication editor.
causes.other: Consult the source record to verify this prerequisite. Funding determines its state.

consent.title: Public consent · Record an agreement received
consent.intro: Use this form only when a person has already given an explicit agreement and you can identify its evidence. This action records the agreement received; it does not request or invent consent.
consent.scope: Public sponsor profile: organization name and presentation.
consent.separate: Image usage rights, social publication authorization and payment remain separate checks.
consent.existing: The required public consent is already recorded.
consent.recordingActor: Recorded by the authenticated Funding actor:
consent.invalidation: Funding invalidated {{count}} affected delivery approval(s). Review the current versions before authorizing delivery again.
consent.noPublication: No email was sent. Public visibility remains on hold; this action publishes no content.
consent.agreement: I confirm that an explicit agreement for the purpose above has already been received.
consent.dateHelp: Enter the actual calendar date of the agreement. Future dates are refused using America/Toronto.
consent.evidenceHelp: Identify the agreement received, for example a dated message or an internal document reference. Required, 1 to 1,000 characters. This reference is private; no document is downloaded or sent.
consent.readonly: Your role permits viewing the consent state. Recording an agreement and its private evidence requires an authorized operator.
consent.confirm: Record the explicit agreement received on {{date}} for the public sponsor name and presentation? Its private reference will be audited. No email or publication is triggered; affected delivery approvals must be reviewed again.

blockers.already_granted: Public consent has already been granted.
blockers.permission_required: Your role cannot record a documented agreement.
blockers.operation_processing: A consent operation is in progress. Wait and read the recorded state before continuing.
blockers.operation_uncertain: A previous consent operation has an uncertain result. Check its recorded receipt before continuing.

messages.loadFailed: Consent could not be read. Try reading its current state again.
messages.conflict: Consent changed in another session. Your entries are retained. Explicitly read the current state before submitting a new confirmed request.
messages.uncertain: The result is uncertain. Check the exact receipt before continuing. No command will be replayed automatically.
messages.notFound: The exact receipt was not found. You may explicitly confirm a retry of the same request; its identity and content are retained.
messages.receiptMismatch: The receipt could not be verified against the acknowledged request. Keep this dossier open and check its receipt again.
messages.recorded: The exact receipt was verified and the current service preparation was read again. No preparation approval was inferred.
messages.refreshRequired: Read the current consent and preparation state before continuing. No previous command will be reconstructed.
messages.invalid: Funding refused the request. Check the actual agreement, date and evidence before submitting a new request.
messages.retainedRequest: A previous request reference was retained for this actor and dossier. Only its recorded receipt can be checked after reopening; the private form was not stored.

decision.title: Proposal decision
decision.scope: This service, this version. Publication and delivery evidence remain separate.
decision.rejectHelp: Reject the content with a reason.

reason.rejected: Why are you rejecting this proposal?
reason.help: A reason is required: 10 to 2,000 characters. Do not include unnecessary sensitive information.
reason.noAutomaticReturn: The request is recorded in Funding. No automatic return to Preflight or cancellation of the service is triggered.

confirm.approved: Approve the {{channel}} preparation for {{reference}}, version {{version}}? This decision publishes no content.
confirm.correction_requested: Record a correction request for {{reference}}, version {{version}}? The previous proposal will be retained.
confirm.rejected: Reject the proposal for {{reference}}, version {{version}}? The delivery obligation will be retained.

decided.approved: Preparation approved for this service. Publication authorization must still be given in Funding.
decided.correction_requested: Correction request recorded. The proposal and reason remain in the history.
decided.rejected: Proposal rejected with a reason. The promised service remains due.

errors.conflict: The version or decision changed in another session. Read the current state; your reason has been retained.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.forbidden: Your role no longer permits this decision.
errors.uncertain: The decision result is unconfirmed. Read the recorded state before continuing; no action is replayed automatically.
